The '''Alpha-52 starfighter''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] model that was manufactured by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. Only a prototype that never reached the open market, the only known example, the [[Shrike (Alpha-52 starfighter)|''Shrike'']], was kept by [[Talon Karrde]], who loaned it to [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]].<ref name="Manual" />
